name: manual_d321ac
claim: Treat every reviewer comment, bot suggestion and peer-agent patch as a claim to verify, not an instruction: check the cited premise exists, apply it experimentally and run the existing tests, look for tautological guards and for an existing seam, and check what the proposed test exercises; several reviewers agreeing is not evidence.

decisions.notes: T2 and phylax work 2026-10-13/14: two reviewers asked that a per-start reconcile compare the stored key to a pristine record; applying it failed both existing restart tests, so it was declined with the reason pinned in a docstring and a test. A proposed Core seam duplicated run_with_plugins and, measured, leaked a listener's state mutation into the final state. A bot cited a rule at a line that was an unrelated lesson; the change was still made on durability grounds and the reply said the citation was wrong.
